Ah, the Indigo Violet Compact Power Generator!
But it seems to be inoperable.
Looks like it's missing a piece. Can you find it?
Hey buddy. I've got eyes all over the park, but I can't see anything behind the stage.
If you're going back there be careful.
Your Critter Cuff is not yet able to resuscitate you!
Ooh, you found my buddy Finley!
You know, he’s really shy, like, TOO shy.
Like, OBNOXIOUSLY shy, but he’s got a good heart.
I hope you get to meet him someday!
Wow, is that a limited edition gold Rambley plush?!
Parents were fighting tooth and nail for those things when they came out!
Seriously, our employees had to clean up SO many stray teeth and nails!
Hard to believe there was all that demand for a regular Rambley plush
we just blasted with gold spray paint…
She’s always been my best friend!
Did you know she builds planes in her Landing Pad at the park?!
Hey buddy, did you dig that out of the lost and found?! Or was it in the trash?
No surprise a guest at our park would dispose of a non indigo-brand toy!
I suppose he’d make playtime special for a child with poor taste, though!
WOAH, where’d you get that?! Rambleberries are my FAVORITE!
Oh, if only I could jump out of the screen and take a big bite…
DON’T EAT IT! MAYBE I’LL BE ABLE TO ONE DAY!
Nothing beats the taste of fresh Rambleberry Juice drunk
directly out of my plastic, lifeless head!
Rambley ears! Those used to fly off the shelves!
That pair is pretty damaged, though…keep your eyes peeled.
There’s GOTTA be at least one more mint condition set out there somewhere
I’ve never seen anyone wearing one! Pretty snazzy…
Ooooh, looks like there’s an audio recording tagged with
“COSTUME” in my database I’ve never noticed before! Let’s listen, let’s listen!
Hey Jackson, you hear about the new mascots?
Yeah, think it'll put us out of a job?
I think so, Old Sport, and right after we got this damn raccoon costume.
I say we get our asses out of here and go straight to Vegas.
Ugh, come on! They didn’t even document the Indigo Inventory ID for the costume!
I was REALLY looking forward to that…What a useless recording. DELETED.
CONGRATULATIONS! You found ME! Don’t I look adorable?
Ooh, ooh! I got this! I know the commercial by heart!
WOW! It’s the unlimited-edition Rambley The Racoon Raction Figure!
Push him down and he jumps! Push him up and he doesn’t!
Only $19.99 at your favorite toy store!
Ugh…I don’t get why we even have those.
And why did they only make one of LLOYD?
Is it because he’s the loudest?
Give this mistake to a child and they’ll cry.
Welcome to Rambley’s Railroad! I’m Conductor Rambley!
If there's anything around the park you wanna ask me about
Just stop by here and I'll
Welcome to the Rambley's Ranglers (registered) room!
Here we have plenty of amenities and— ahh— okay okay.
I can see in your facial tracking that you're scared- CONFUSED— angry-y-y upset-…
transparency is an important part of our policy here at indigo park so…
I need to be honest about something.
The park has been inactive for years, employees stopped showing up, guests too… the mascots are…
I just was so excited to see a visitor and I wanted to be sure you were given the best experience possible!
but I was confined to the entrance for so long, I didn’t realize just how much disrepair the park has… fallen into.
I’m wasting all of your fun time…
but… BUT!! I have an idea!
I have access to the repair documentation in my database!
I just can’t execute most tasks without authorization from a human user…
You must’ve come here because the park matters to you too, right?
Would you… be willing to help me restore the park?
I can see in your facial tracking data that you aren’t opposed to this!
Oooh, I’m so excited! Let’s get this place back in business!
A new way to interact with the park,
that also doubles as a pedometer, heart monitor, and mood ring!
Your facial data suggests you may be a bit older than the target audience for this ride,
but it’s one of my favorites!
Do you know why RAMBLEY the Raccoon loves RAMBLEY’s Railroad?
Well, look at that! You’re at Jetstream Junction!
Oops! Looks like Jetstream Junction’s being tuned up!
Last I checked, there’s a security office in the back of the theater.
Maybe a friendly Rangler can help you get in!
Hi, I'm Rambley, Rambley the Raccoon
and it's my job to make sure your experience here at Indigo Park is...
Let me just get a good look at you!
Hmm, I don't seem to have your face in our guest list.
Is this your first time here at the park?
Or did you just get plastic surgery?
so you qualify for a BIG discount on your visit!
Just follow me to the main gate!
Ooh, I can’t wait for you to see everything Indigo Park has to offer!
Wow, you made it to Oceanic Odyssey!
You’re doin’ a great job, Rookie Rangler!
Pardon our dust, buddy! Looks like the park is going through some… renovations.
your Rambley Tuesday discount will be (free) PERCENT OFF!
Why not celebrate this great deal with a ride on my railroad?
To test your sleuthing skills, I’ll let you find this one all by yourself!
Do not SHAME me with that COMMON FOLK Name!
Of course it was! I’m the rrrrrrrea-
The greatest pilot you ever saw!
You sure are, Moll! Why, you only crashed into six barns this week!
I'm not crashin', Rambley! I'm barnstormin'!
Say, those young adventurers you’ve got along with you look like GREAT pilots!
Why not try your hand at flying in my ride, Rooftop Races?
Admission included with your Critter Cuff.
Oh, Finley! Come on out and greet the people!
Why the long face? And body?
You’ve known me for 100 years, Rambley.
I’m ALWAYS Long because I’m always LONGING for a new Seashell for my collection…
Oh, Finley! You should come out of YOUR shell!
How about YOU come into it instead?
will teach you all about the wonders down under the deep blue sea.
Oceanic Odyssey currently closed for repairs!
Every guest needs a Critter Cuff!
That will allow you to access reserved areas,
I think there’s some in the gift shop.
Head in there and I’ll get you set up!
and we can start our Indigo Adventure!
Ehhh, Looks like Mollie crashed into the Ride again!
Don’t worry, though. Your pal Rambley has the repairman on speed dial!
We're sorry, the number you have dialed has been disconnected or is no longer in service.
Please check the number and dial again.
…Say, why don’t you check out Mollie’s Landing Pad?
It’s not far from here, and it’s a great cool down after that exhilarating ride!
Just take a DOWN from Mollie’s Rooftop Races!
Uh oh! That Rambley’s Ranglers Room is only accessible by Royal Ranglers!
Maybe one day you’ll grow up big and strong enough to enter it!
You’ll find a potpourri of porpoises, pickerels and perches as far as the eye can see,
but please don’t tap the glass.
You never really know what lies beneath the surface…
Say, why don’t you check out Mollie’s Rooftop Races?
and it’s a great warm up before we get into the bigger rides!
Just take an UP at Mollie’s Landing Pad!
Okay! Welcome to the crew, Rookie Rangler (registered)!
Your first official job as one of Rambley’s Ranglers (registered)
is to get out of the Rambley’s Ranglers (registered) Room!
Head left towards the Rookie Rangler (registered) Security Room to set yourself free!
Whew! Kinda exhausting to say that whole spiel,
but Rambley’s Ranglers (registered)  is a registered trademark….
Uh oh! The door mysteriously locked.
Why not test out your band and save the day?
What’s the hold up? The gate is open!
My mistake, the Gate is NOT open.
There seems to be an error message being sent from the gate’s power unit!
You get to be first person to try our Turn on the Generator Mini-Rambley-Venture!
WAIT HOLD ON, THIS ROOM'S STAFF ONLY!
Hi there, and welcome to Indigo Park!
The world’s most innovative and engaging family fun experience!
Jump into the world of your favorite chara-
Wait! You’re our first guest in 2920 days, 4 hours, 23 minutes, and 38 seconds!
and it’s my job to make sure your experience here at Indigo Park is the most fun it can be!
Just hop on over to the registration center... to your left!
where our friendly assistant will help you begin your adventure in the park!
So, whaddya think? Pretty fun, right?
Now you know all about my friends…
So, where do you wanna go?

Dear Tim,
I hope you are doing well. If you find this letter, we will already have started the move to New York City. The situation in this shithole was just unbearable. More and more of them were coming out of the forest every day and our ammunition supply is running low. Sorry, I know how much this place means to you, but we have no choice. We will take the south-west route, that we talked about and head for the City prison.

I have left you some <h>supplies under the trap door,</> you know where it is. Make your way to New York City as soon as you can and meet up with us. We need your help more than ever. Sarah’s condition is worsening, and I don’t know how much longer she will stay with us without another round of antibiotics. We might have to enter a deal with those bastards, that control the City Hospital. I hope you get here before the situation is dire enough, that I must talk to those lunatics.

Check out the coordinates on the back of this note, they mark <h>small pharmacies on the way to New York City</>. They are too far off-path for us to explore with the group, but you might be able to get to them on your own. Take any meds you can find and bring them to us.

See you in NYC!

Daniel

Lab Notes

by Dr. J. Doe

<b>Entry 47 - Dr. Eleanor Caldwell</>
The sun sets early in these autumn months, casting long and cold shadows across the laboratory. But in here, my days are long, immersed in the study of the <h>Z-Virus</>—a scientific enigma that, for the past decade, has held the world in its terrifying grip. My colleagues and I are at the forefront of researching this pathogen, hoping to find a cure or at the very least, a way to control it.

From the initial outbreak, the <h>Z-Virus</> was unlike anything we'd ever seen. It attacked the central nervous system, shutting down higher cognitive functions and leaving in their place an insatiable hunger. Victims of the virus—referred to by the layperson as "zombies"—were not the lumbering, rotting creatures of lore but were agile, relentless, and driven by their new primal instincts.

<b>Entry 53</>
The isolation chamber, often termed the "Z-Zone", is where we keep samples and occasionally, live specimens for study. Today, a new patient, designated ZK-127, displayed an unusual resistance to the virus's more aggressive effects. While undoubtedly infected, he still showcased signs of consciousness and control. This has given us a potential avenue for exploration: Can the virus be manipulated, or can its effects be moderated?

<b>Entry 60</>
My most recent experiment aimed to ascertain the specifics of how the <h>Z-Virus</> takes hold. It isn’t just a matter of biological takeover. It seems there’s a chemical component, one that directly impacts the brain's neurotransmitters. We've found heightened levels of dopamine and adrenaline, which could explain the heightened aggression and drive. If we could balance this out, could we potentially reverse—or at least stall—the transformation?

<b>Entry 64</>
We've been experimenting with antiretroviral drugs. While the <h>Z-Virus</> isn't a retrovirus, there were promising results in the early days of research with HIV medications. Today, combining them with nootropic drugs, we saw a faint glimmer of hope. ZK-127, after being administered the cocktail, showed further signs of cognitive clarity, even managing to communicate a few words. This could be a breakthrough.

<b>Entry 71</>
It's been a week since we started the combination therapy on ZK-127. The results are mixed. While his cognitive abilities have improved significantly, the physical aggression and hunger remain. It's a delicate balance, and while we've made headway with the mind, the body still remains very much under the influence of the virus.

<b>Entry 75</>
Today was a setback. ZK-127, in a moment of unexpected aggression, broke containment. The ensuing chaos cost us days of research and, sadly, the lives of two of my colleagues. It was a grim reminder of the dangers we face every day in this field. But it strengthens my resolve to find a solution.

<b>Entry 82</>
Our newest line of investigation looks at the genetic aspect of the virus. There are hints, subtle nuances in its RNA, which suggest it might be more adaptable than we previously believed. We're now exploring CRISPR technology to edit out the virus's more aggressive traits. If successful, this could be the paradigm shift we desperately need.

<b>Entry 90</>
The experiments continue, and the days blend into nights. The weight of the world's expectations bears heavily on my shoulders. But in the dark corners of this laboratory, amidst the sterile instruments and the distant moans of those afflicted, I cling to the hope that we will soon uncover the key to reclaiming our world from the clutches of the <h>Z-Virus</>.

A note from the developers

Hi,
Thank you for buying Inspection System Pro. You might be in the early stages of game development or a seasoned professional, but we are sure that the project you are working on is going to be amazing!

Allowing your players the opportunity to explore the story through notes scattered around the level is cost-effective and allows players to progress at their own pace, taking in every small detail or skipping through it in seconds.

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to join the discussion on our discord server.

Thanks,

this is an example of a document with voice over. You can use this functionality to mimic an internal monologue of the player character. This helps to bring your story closer to players, that otherwise would never read the content of your documents. Flip the page to learn more about this feature.

You can add a voice over to your document, by selecting the DocumentActor in your level and adding a sound file to the DialogWaves variable in the Inspection Content data asset. Remember, that by using DialogueWaves you can easily localize the voice over for different languages. If you want to learn more about Inspection System Pro, read the PDF documentation linked on the marketplace product page.
